reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur), 0) AS margin_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur - unit_cost_eur * units)) AS margin_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY parent_category

SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL THEN net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur END), 0) AS margin_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur - unit_cost_eur * units)) AS margin_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY parent_category
other_way.tradeoff: Two comparisons give the same rows, but BETWEEN states the range in one short test.
